rows.historical_evidence: Classic midden-on-worker-failure evidence retained in 201-CLASSIC-SYNTHESIS.md (SYN-201-11); recordDispatchWorkerOutcome now resolves the phase's own latest durable build attempt to bind a failed worker's midden entry to the exact attempt and job identity, closing the gap between the reusable appendMiddenEntry writer and a build worker's own failure moment (NOW-17).

Classic worker-blocker-as-flag evidence retained in 201-CLASSIC-SYNTHESIS.md (SYN-201-06/SYN-201-11); a worker-reported blocker is now a durable colony.FlagEntry (Source: escalation, AttemptID set) appended into the same pending-decisions.json file advancement, status, and closure already read from, so all three surfaces see it consistently (NOW-18).

Classic plan-vs-reality task evidence verification retained in 201-CLASSIC-SYNTHESIS.md (SYN-201-11); the unified accept/verify/advance function (SYN-201-04, cmd/codex_verify_advance.go) routes every continue lane through the one deterministic floor, proven the only source of a pass across the direct, plan-only, and external finalize lanes (NOW-03).

Classic unresolved-flags/recurring-midden patrol review evidence retained in 201-CLASSIC-SYNTHESIS.md (SYN-201-10/SYN-201-11); repairEligibilityEvaluation now wraps classifyAutopilotRepairFailure with unresolved blocker flags and a recurring failure class as inputs, naming which one drove the recorded reason, inside the one bounded-recovery model rather than a separate patrol mechanism.

Classic quick-work evidence retained in 201-CLASSIC-SYNTHESIS.md (SYN-201-12); /ant-quick's request now opens a real attempt, records a no-change or checked verdict, and produces exactly one attempt-bound failure record on error, replacing the prior read-only Scout-research-only shape (NOW-20).

Ledger marks CAP-051 restore-modern (already proven, Phase 198.3); this row signs it with a proof executed in this session rather than carrying the earlier-phase label forward -- readBlockerSnapshotEvidence remains the single escalated-blocker counting function, and the worker-reported blocker this phase's own CAP-004 work introduced is counted by it with zero changes (NOW-19).

Classic chamber-compare diff evidence retained in 201-CLASSIC-SYNTHESIS.md (SYN-201-13); deriveBuildKnowledgeDeltas now produces an attempt's own content-level decision and learning deltas from its workers' own handoffs, attached on both build lanes and rendered read-only at the closeout that consumes them -- routed as attempt-bound evidence rather than a revived standalone chamber-compare command.

Classic legacy root-level artifact-filename evidence retained in 201-CLASSIC-SYNTHESIS.md (SYN-201-09); claims and verification artifacts are written through one canonical attempt-bound path (attemptBoundArtifactPath), with a legacy-compatible reader validated by the exact same containment rules as the attempt-bound path, confirming no remaining write path uses the bare legacy root filenames (NOW-21).
